name: FREITAG Card Wallet
about: A small wallet made from recycled truck tarpaulin, a material tied to Zurich's streets. The brand was founded here and the bags are made from old truck covers.
tip: Prices vary by model, so compare the card slot layout and price across models before you buy.

name: Zurich Handmade Chocolate
about: A long-running Zurich confectionery known for fine chocolates. It is a classic local gift from the city.
tip: Some fresh chocolates are made the same day and have short shelf lives, so check the best-before date before you buy.
